# Component Composition in Blazor


Blazor components compose just like Flutter widgets! You build larger components by nesting smaller ones.


## Component Hierarchy


```
┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
│         App.razor                   │
│  ┌───────────────────────────────┐  │
│  │     MainLayout.razor          │  │
│  │  ┌─────────────────────────┐  │  │
│  │  │   ProductList.razor     │  │  │
│  │  │  ┌─────────────────┐    │  │  │
│  │  │  │ProductCard.razor│    │  │  │
│  │  │  │  - Name         │    │  │  │
│  │  │  │  - Price        │    │  │  │
│  │  │  │  - Button       │    │  │  │
│  │  │  └─────────────────┘    │  │  │
│  │  │  └─────────────────┘    │  │  │
│  │  │  └─────────────────┘    │  │  │
│  │  └─────────────────────────┘  │  │
│  └───────────────────────────────┘  │
└─────────────────────────────────────┘
```


## 1. Basic Component Usage


### Child Component: `ProductCard.razor`

```razor
<div class="card">
    <h4>Product Name</h4>
    <p>$99.99</p>
</div>
```


### Parent Component: Using the Child

```razor
@page "/products"

<h2>Our Products</h2>

<!-- Use component like an HTML tag -->
<ProductCard />
<ProductCard />
<ProductCard />
```


## 2. Passing Data with Parameters


Think of `[Parameter]` like Flutter's constructor parameters or React props.


### Child Component with Parameters

```razor
<!-- ProductCard.razor -->

<div class="card">
    <h4>@Name</h4>
    <p>@Price.ToString("C")</p>
    <p>@Description</p>
</div>

@code {
    [Parameter]
    public string Name { get; set; } = "";
    
    [Parameter]
    public decimal Price { get; set; }
    
    [Parameter]
    public string Description { get; set; } = "";
}
```


### Parent Component: Passing Data

```razor
<!-- ProductList.razor -->

<div class="product-grid">
    <ProductCard 
        Name="Laptop" 
        Price="1299.99m" 
        Description="High-performance laptop" />
    
    <ProductCard 
        Name="Mouse" 
        Price="29.99m" 
        Description="Wireless mouse" />
    
    <!-- Or loop through data -->
    @foreach (var product in products)
    {
        <ProductCard 
            Name="@product.Name"
            Price="@product.Price"
            Description="@product.Description" />
    }
</div>

@code {
    private List<Product> products = new();
}
```


## 3. Child Content (Slot Pattern)


Like Flutter's `children` property or React's `{children}`. Use `RenderFragment` for flexible content.


```
Data Flow Patterns
──────────────────

Pattern 1: Parameters (Parent → Child)
┌────────┐
│ Parent │ ──[Parameter]──> │ Child │
└────────┘                  └───────┘

Pattern 2: Events (Child → Parent)
┌────────┐
│ Parent │ <──[EventCallback]── │ Child │
└────────┘                       └───────┘

Pattern 3: Child Content (Parent provides markup)
┌────────┐
│ Parent │ ──[ChildContent]──> │ Child │
└────────┘                      └───────┘
```


### Child Component with ChildContent

```razor
<!-- Card.razor -->

<div class="card @CssClass">
    <div class="card-header">
        @HeaderContent
    </div>
    <div class="card-body">
        @ChildContent
    </div>
    @if (FooterContent != null)
    {
        <div class="card-footer">
            @FooterContent
        </div>
    }
</div>

@code {
    [Parameter]
    public RenderFragment? ChildContent { get; set; }
    
    [Parameter]
    public RenderFragment? HeaderContent { get; set; }
    
    [Parameter]
    public RenderFragment? FooterContent { get; set; }
    
    [Parameter]
    public string CssClass { get; set; } = "";
}
```


### Using the Card Component

```razor
<Card CssClass="highlight">
    <HeaderContent>
        <h3>Product Details</h3>
    </HeaderContent>
    <ChildContent>
        <p>This is the main content</p>
        <img src="product.jpg" />
        <button>Buy Now</button>
    </ChildContent>
    <FooterContent>
        <small>Last updated: @DateTime.Now</small>
    </FooterContent>
</Card>
```


## 4. Event Callbacks (Child to Parent Communication)


Like Flutter's callback functions `onPressed: () { }`.


### Child Component: Button with Event

```razor
<!-- CounterButton.razor -->

<button class="btn btn-primary" @onclick="HandleClick">
    @Label (@Count)
</button>

@code {
    [Parameter]
    public string Label { get; set; } = "Click me";
    
    [Parameter]
    public int Count { get; set; }
    
    [Parameter]
    public EventCallback<int> OnCountChanged { get; set; }
    
    private async Task HandleClick()
    {
        Count++;
        // Notify parent of the change
        await OnCountChanged.InvokeAsync(Count);
    }
}
```


### Parent Component: Handling Events

```razor
<!-- Counter.razor -->
@page "/counter"

<h3>Counter Page</h3>

<p>Total clicks: @totalClicks</p>

<CounterButton 
    Label="Button 1" 
    Count="@count1" 
    OnCountChanged="@HandleCount1Changed" />

<CounterButton 
    Label="Button 2" 
    Count="@count2" 
    OnCountChanged="@HandleCount2Changed" />

@code {
    private int count1 = 0;
    private int count2 = 0;
    private int totalClicks = 0;
    
    private void HandleCount1Changed(int newCount)
    {
        count1 = newCount;
        totalClicks = count1 + count2;
    }
    
    private void HandleCount2Changed(int newCount)
    {
        count2 = newCount;
        totalClicks = count1 + count2;
    }
}
```


## 5. Cascading Parameters (Deep Hierarchy)


For passing data through multiple levels without prop drilling (like Flutter's InheritedWidget or React Context).


```
Without Cascading (Prop Drilling)
──────────────────────────────────
App
 ├─ theme ──> Page
              ├─ theme ──> Section
                           ├─ theme ──> Card
                                        └─ Uses theme

With Cascading (Direct Access)
───────────────────────────────
App (provides theme)
 └─ Page
     └─ Section
         └─ Card (accesses theme directly)
```


### Providing Cascading Value

```razor
<!-- App.razor or MainLayout.razor -->

<CascadingValue Value="@currentUser">
    <CascadingValue Value="@theme">
        @Body
    </CascadingValue>
</CascadingValue>

@code {
    private User currentUser = new() { Name = "John Doe" };
    private Theme theme = new() { PrimaryColor = "blue" };
}
```


### Consuming Cascading Value (Any Level Deep)

```razor
<!-- UserProfile.razor (deep in the tree) -->

<div>
    <p>Welcome, @CurrentUser.Name</p>
    <p style="color: @Theme.PrimaryColor">Themed text</p>
</div>

@code {
    [CascadingParameter]
    public User CurrentUser { get; set; } = null!;
    
    [CascadingParameter]
    public Theme Theme { get; set; } = null!;
}
```


## 6. Complete Real-World Example


### Small Components


```razor
<!-- Components/ProductImage.razor -->

<div class="product-image">
    <img src="@ImageUrl" alt="@Alt" />
</div>

@code {
    [Parameter] public string ImageUrl { get; set; } = "";
    [Parameter] public string Alt { get; set; } = "";
}
```

```razor
<!-- Components/PriceDisplay.razor -->

<div class="price">
    @if (OriginalPrice.HasValue && OriginalPrice > Price)
    {
        <span class="original-price">@OriginalPrice.Value.ToString("C")</span>
    }
    <span class="current-price">@Price.ToString("C")</span>
    @if (Discount > 0)
    {
        <span class="discount">-@Discount%</span>
    }
</div>

@code {
    [Parameter] public decimal Price { get; set; }
    [Parameter] public decimal? OriginalPrice { get; set; }
    [Parameter] public int Discount { get; set; }
}
```

```razor
<!-- Components/AddToCartButton.razor -->

<button class="btn-cart" @onclick="HandleClick" disabled="@IsLoading">
    @if (IsLoading)
    {
        <span>Adding...</span>
    }
    else
    {
        <span>@Text</span>
    }
</button>

@code {
    [Parameter] public string Text { get; set; } = "Add to Cart";
    [Parameter] public EventCallback OnClick { get; set; }
    [Parameter] public bool IsLoading { get; set; }
    
    private async Task HandleClick()
    {
        await OnClick.InvokeAsync();
    }
}
```


### Medium Component (Combines Small Ones)


```razor
<!-- Components/ProductCard.razor -->

<div class="product-card">
    <ProductImage 
        ImageUrl="@Product.ImageUrl" 
        Alt="@Product.Name" />
    
    <div class="product-info">
        <h3>@Product.Name</h3>
        <p>@Product.Description</p>
        
        <PriceDisplay 
            Price="@Product.Price"
            OriginalPrice="@Product.OriginalPrice"
            Discount="@Product.DiscountPercent" />
        
        <AddToCartButton 
            OnClick="@(() => OnAddToCart.InvokeAsync(Product))"
            IsLoading="@isAdding" />
    </div>
</div>

@code {
    [Parameter] public Product Product { get; set; } = null!;
    [Parameter] public EventCallback<Product> OnAddToCart { get; set; }
    
    private bool isAdding = false;
}
```


### Large Component (Combines Medium Ones)


```razor
<!-- Pages/ProductList.razor -->
@page "/products"
@inject CartService CartService

<div class="product-list-page">
    <h1>Our Products</h1>
    
    @if (isLoading)
    {
        <p>Loading products...</p>
    }
    else
    {
        <div class="product-grid">
            @foreach (var product in products)
            {
                <ProductCard 
                    Product="@product"
                    OnAddToCart="@HandleAddToCart" />
            }
        </div>
    }
    
    @if (cartMessage != "")
    {
        <div class="toast">@cartMessage</div>
    }
</div>

@code {
    private List<Product> products = new();
    private bool isLoading = true;
    private string cartMessage = "";
    
    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        await Task.Delay(500); // Simulate loading
        products = GetSampleProducts();
        isLoading = false;
    }
    
    private async Task HandleAddToCart(Product product)
    {
        await CartService.AddItem(product);
        cartMessage = $"Added {product.Name} to cart!";
        
        // Clear message after 3 seconds
        await Task.Delay(3000);
        cartMessage = "";
        StateHasChanged();
    }
    
    private List<Product> GetSampleProducts()
    {
        return new List<Product>
        {
            new() { Name = "Laptop", Price = 1299.99m, ImageUrl = "laptop.jpg" },
            new() { Name = "Mouse", Price = 29.99m, ImageUrl = "mouse.jpg" }
        };
    }
}
```


## Key Patterns Summary


```
Component Communication Patterns
─────────────────────────────────

1. [Parameter] - Pass data down
   Parent ─[data]──> Child

2. [EventCallback] - Send events up
   Parent <─[event]── Child

3. [ChildContent] - Custom markup
   Parent ─[markup]──> Child

4. [CascadingParameter] - Skip levels
   Ancestor ╌╌╌[shared data]╌╌╌> Descendant

5. @ref - Direct reference (use sparingly)
   Parent ─[direct access]──> Child
```


This composition model is very similar to Flutter! Each component is self-contained, reusable, and communicates through well-defined interfaces. Start small, then combine them into larger features!
